title: Info Labelling – RFQ/RFP document and paragraph labels
description: MVP facet schema v0.1. One record per document (level=document) or per extracted paragraph/table row (level=paragraph, keyed by anchor_id from extract_paragraphs.py). Use $defs/ParagraphFacets alone for LLM constrained generation.

x-enumDescriptions.prime: Issued by the customer/Prime: RFQ/RFP package, requirements, contract drafts.
x-enumDescriptions.supplier: Issued by the bidder/supplier: offer, proposal, plans, product documentation.

x-enumDescriptions.invitation_to_tender: [prime] ITT/RFQ/RFP letter: scope, deadlines, response format.
x-enumDescriptions.document_requirements_list: [prime] DRL/DRD: documents to deliver and their content.
x-enumDescriptions.draft_contract: [prime] Draft contract, special or general conditions of purchase.
x-enumDescriptions.price_form: [prime] Price breakdown template to fill in.
x-enumDescriptions.cover_letter: [supplier] Offer/cover letter summarising the proposal and its conditions.
x-enumDescriptions.technical_proposal: [supplier] Technical proposal specific to this bid.
x-enumDescriptions.development_plan: [supplier] Design, development and verification plan, management plan.
x-enumDescriptions.financial_proposal: [supplier] Price offer, cost breakdown, payment plan.
x-enumDescriptions.terms_of_sale: [supplier] General terms and conditions of sale.
x-enumDescriptions.other: Anything not covered above; explain in note.

x-enumDescriptions.requirement: Binding obligation on the recipient (shall, must, is required to).
x-enumDescriptions.option: Permission or selectable option (may, optional, can be offered).
x-enumDescriptions.commitment: The author commits to an action, process or deliverable (will, we perform, is performed for the project).
x-enumDescriptions.compliance_statement: States compliance, partial compliance, deviation or non-compliance to a requirement or standard.
x-enumDescriptions.description: Factual property of a product, system or facility: what it is, has or does.
x-enumDescriptions.definition: Acronym, glossary entry or definition of a term.
x-enumDescriptions.reference: Content is delegated to another document (see AD-3, as documented in [EEE]).
x-enumDescriptions.bidder_instruction: Instruction on how to prepare or submit the bid (format, deadline, contacts).
x-enumDescriptions.context: Purpose, scope, introduction, background; no obligation, commitment or product fact.

x-enumDescriptions.verification: Tests, analyses, inspections, reviews of design, qualification, acceptance.
x-enumDescriptions.product_assurance: Quality, dependability, safety, EEE parts, materials and processes, NCR.
x-enumDescriptions.management: Organisation, configuration, risk, reporting, meetings, subcontractors.
x-enumDescriptions.schedule: Milestones, durations, dates, phases, delivery times.
x-enumDescriptions.deliverables: Documents, hardware, software or data to be delivered.
x-enumDescriptions.commercial: Prices, payment, validity, warranty terms with a price impact.
x-enumDescriptions.legal: Liability, IPR, confidentiality, export control, governing law.

x-enumDescriptions.P: Relevant to the proposal/qualification: technical and compliance answer.
x-enumDescriptions.Q: Relevant to the quotation: price, cost, payment.
x-enumDescriptions.none: Not relevant to either (context, definitions, boilerplate).

x-enumDescriptions.declare_compliance: [prime docs] Supplier must state C/PC/NC for this paragraph.
x-enumDescriptions.produce_deliverable: [prime docs] Supplier must deliver a document, item or data.
x-enumDescriptions.quote: [prime docs] Supplier must price this item.
x-enumDescriptions.provide_information: [prime docs] Supplier must provide information in the proposal.
x-enumDescriptions.none: No action, or the document is on the supplier side.

x-enumDescriptions.ok: Record is one complete, meaningful unit.
x-enumDescriptions.fragment: Incomplete: split sentence, cut table row, diagram label.
x-enumDescriptions.noise: Should not exist: header, footer, page number, letterhead.
x-enumDescriptions.bad_merge: Two or more unrelated units merged into one record.

x-enumDescriptions.multiple_requirements: The record contains more than one separately verifiable requirement.

ParagraphFacets.description: Facets only. Use this object as the LLM output schema.
